children: Bitcoin miner holdings reached about 1.1919 million BTC as of September 5 at 2:00 PM, up 261 BTC from a week earlier. According to ChainCatcher, this was the first weekly increase of that size in roughly two weeks, since August 26.

Over the same period, Bitcoin's 7-day average hashrate rose to about 934 million TH/s, up roughly 41.11 million TH/s from a week earlier. Bitcoin's Puell Multiple also climbed to 1, an increase of 0.04 from the previous week.

title: Bitcoin Miner Holdings Rise for First Time in Two Weeks as Hashrate and Puell Multiple Increase
